skills.name: Circles and circumference
skills.key: Diameter = 2 x radius. C = pi x d = 2 x pi x r. Circumference / diameter is always pi.
tiers: radius <-> diameter
C from d or r using 3.14 or leaving in terms of pi
d or r from C
context: turn radius to distance flown in a full circle; wheel rotations
skills.gen: r in [1,50]; accept answers within 0.5% for 3.14 and exact for 'pi' form.

errors.desc: uses r where d is given

skills.skin: holding-pattern circle, turn radius, radar dish rim

skills.name: Areas of circles
skills.key: A = pi x r^2. Square the radius FIRST, then multiply by pi. If given the diameter, halve it first.
tiers: A from r
A from d; semicircle area
r from A
circumference vs area: which is asked, in context
skills.gen: r in [1,40]; T2 semicircles; T3 A chosen so r is a whole number.
skills.skin: radar sweep area, area covered by a flare, circular landing pad

skills.name: Perimeters and areas of composite figures
skills.key: Cut the figure into rectangles, triangles, and half-circles; add (or subtract a cutout). Perimeter counts only the OUTSIDE edges.
tiers: L-shape from rectangles
rectangle plus semicircle (apron/runway end)
area with a cutout; perimeter with a curved edge
area between two shapes
skills.gen: Dimensions in [2,40]; semicircle diameters even; grid drawings supplied.

errors.desc: counts interior segments in the perimeter
uses full circle for a semicircle
adds the cutout instead of subtracting

skills.skin: runway and apron layouts, hangar floor with a cutout, target zone shapes

skills.name: Constructing polygons and the triangle inequality
skills.key: Three side lengths make a triangle only if the two shorter ones add to MORE than the longest. Three sides fix one unique triangle; three angles (summing to 180) allow infinitely many.
tiers: can these three sides form a triangle?
unique / many / none from given conditions
possible range for the third side
draw a quadrilateral from side and angle descriptions (multiple choice of figures)

errors.desc: three angles give a unique triangle

skills.skin: triangular intercept geometry, three legs of a patrol route

skills.name: Finding unknown angle measures
skills.key: Complementary = 90, supplementary = 180, vertical angles are equal, adjacent angles share a side. Name the relationship, write the equation, solve, then answer the ANGLE (not just x).
tiers: name the relationship; find the other angle
vertical and adjacent angles at a crossing
write and solve an equation: (3x) and (2x + 20) supplementary
multi-step figure combining relationships
skills.gen: Angles in [10,170]; T3 choose x so all angles are whole.

errors.desc: reports x instead of the angle

skills.skin: crossing flight paths, intercept headings, bank angle relationships

skills.name: Surface areas of prisms
skills.key: Surface area is the total area of ALL the faces. Use a net or S = 2B + Ph (two bases plus the lateral faces).
tiers: rectangular prism from a net
cube; triangular prism
lateral area only; missing dimension from S
context: paint needed for a container, compare volume and surface area
skills.gen: Dimensions in [1,20]; triangular prisms with 3-4-5 style bases.
skills.skin: paint for a fuel crate, hangar wall panels, ordnance container

skills.name: Surface areas of cylinders
skills.key: Unroll it: two circles plus a rectangle whose width is the circumference. S = 2 pi r^2 + 2 pi r h.
tiers: S from r and h with pi = 3.14
S from d and h; leave in terms of pi
lateral area only
context: label on a fuel drum

errors.desc: uses d for the rectangle width

skills.skin: external fuel tank, engine nacelle, drum labels
skills.note: No IM 6-8 match; Big Ideas maps this to 7.G.B.3. Treat as core because it is on the syllabus topics list.

skills.name: Surface areas of pyramids
skills.key: S = base area + the triangular faces. Each triangle uses the SLANT height, not the pyramid's height.
tiers: square pyramid from a net
triangular pyramid
lateral area with slant height given
distinguish slant height from height
skills.gen: Base edge in [2,20], slant height in [3,25].

errors.desc: uses height instead of slant height

skills.skin: radar cone housing, tent hangar, pyramidal target marker
skills.note: TN 7.G.B.5 names cubes and right prisms only; keep as enrichment tier within the campaign.

skills.name: Volumes of prisms
skills.key: V = B x h: area of the base times the height. Works for any prism; the base is the face that repeats.
tiers: rectangular prism V = Bh
triangular and trapezoidal prisms
missing dimension from V; fractional dimensions
context: fuel tank capacity, compare two tanks

errors.desc: uses a non-base face for B

skills.skin: fuel tank in liters, cargo bay, hangar volume

skills.name: Volumes of pyramids
skills.key: A pyramid holds one third of the prism with the same base and height: V = (1/3) B h.
tiers: square pyramid V
triangular pyramid V
compare pyramid to prism with the same base
missing height from V
skills.gen: Base edges in [2,20], heights chosen so V is whole.
skills.skin: nose cone volume approximated by a pyramid, ordnance crate
skills.note: Enrichment per TN standard text; on the syllabus topics list.

skills.name: Cross sections of three-dimensional figures
skills.key: A slice parallel to the base is a copy of the base. A slice perpendicular to the base of a prism is a rectangle. A pyramid sliced parallel to its base gives a smaller version of the base.
tiers: cross section of a prism parallel to the base
perpendicular slices of prisms and cylinders
pyramids and cones sliced parallel and perpendicular
diagonal slices; identify the solid from a set of cross sections
skills.gen: Solids: rectangular prism, triangular prism, cylinder, square pyramid, cone; slice directions rotated.

errors.desc: every slice of a pyramid is a triangle

skills.skin: fuselage and wing cross sections, fuel tank baffles
